title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 077 ]

blocks.text: According to some experts, we are leaving our children and grandchildren a frightening inheritance : an increased accumulation of so-called greenhouse gases in the atmosphere and the potentially disastrous climate changes that this increase may bring about. However, the scientific communityis not speaking with one voice . Other scientists claim that they evidence for global warming is inconclusive and argue that predictions based on it are questionable. The scientific debate has been intense. It has also fueled a political controversy about what measures, if any, should be taken to address the possible problem of climate changes.

readingSentences.english: According to some experts, we are leaving our children and grandchildren a frightening inheritance : an increased accumulation of so-called greenhouse gases in the atmosphere and the potentially disastrous climate changes that this increase may bring about.
readingSentences.korean: 일부 전문가들에 따르면, 우리가 우리의 자녀들과 손자들이 끔찍한 유산을 남기고 있다고 한다. 즉, 그 유산은 대기권에의 이른바 온실 가스의 증대된 누적 현상 및 이러한 증대 현상이 초래하게 될 가능성이 높은 불행스러운 기후의 변화이다.

readingSentences.english: However, the scientific communityis not speaking with one voice .
readingSentences.korean: 그러나, 과학계는 한 목소리를 내지 못하고 있다(의견이 대립되고 있다).

readingSentences.english: Other scientists claim that they evidence for global warming is inconclusive and argue that predictions based on it are questionable.
readingSentences.korean: 다른 과학자들은 지구 온난화에 대한 증거는 결정적인 것이 되지 못한다고 주장하고, 또한 이에 기초한 예측들은 의심스러운 것이라고 주장한다.

readingSentences.english: The scientific debate has been intense.
It has also fueled a political controversy about what measures, if any, should be taken to address the possible problem of climate changes.
readingSentences.korean: 이 논쟁은 또한 기후 변화라는 있을 수도 있을 문제에 대처하기 위하여 그 조치가 존재한다면 어떤 조치를 취해야 하는가에 대한 정치적인 논쟁에 연료를 대고 있다(논쟁을 더 격렬하게 만들고 있다).
